en.hubeali: Al-Husayn Bin Muhammad Al-Ashary, from Abdullah Bin Aamir, from Ali Bin Mahziyar, from Fazalat Bin Ayoub, and Hammad Bin Isa, from Muawiya Bin Wahaba who said,
‘I asked Abu Abdullahasws about the most superior of the timings for Al-Witr. So heasws said: ‘The dawn is the beginning of that’.
en.sarwar: 23. Al-Husayn ibn Muhammad al-Ash’ariy has narrated from ‘Abd Allah ibn ‘Amir Ali ibn Mahziyar from Fadalah ibn Ayyub and Hammad ibn ‘Isa from Mu‘awiyah ibn Wahab who has said the following: “I once asked abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, about the most excellent time for al-Witr. He (the Imam) said, ‘Dawn is the beginning of it.”
